title: COMMON HARVEST — A shared rooftop garden for growing and gathering, 6 deliverables

# COMMON HARVEST

## Community and identity
- Setting: shared apartment rooftop in a temperate climate.
- Residents: 12; maintenance teams: six pairs.
- Simultaneous seated capacity: four people.
- Site name: COMMON HARVEST.
- Activity areas: Growing Table; Evening Bench.
- Maintenance-station phrase: Grow together, take a turn.
- Existing identity: pale grey concrete pavers, teal stair door #2F6F73, galvanized equipment plinth.

## Geometry and coordinates
- Coordinate origin: southwest roof corner; x east; y north; coordinates in mm.
- Roof boundary: (0, 0), (12000, 0), (12000, 8000), (0, 8000).
- Roof area: 96 m².
- Parapet height above finished terrace: 1100 mm.
- Stair enclosure clear structural headroom: 2400 mm.
- Perimeter access strip: 500 mm inside the roof boundary, except the existing stair enclosure footprint.
- Equipment and drain maintenance clearance: 500 mm from each equipment edge or drain centre.
- Connecting route clear width: 1200 mm.
- Existing paver module: 500 × 500 mm.

| Existing element | Position or extent |
|---|---|
| Stair enclosure | x = 0–3000; y = 0–2000 |
| Stair door | East enclosure wall at x = 3000; y = 500–1700; inward opening |
| Equipment plinth | x = 9000–11000; y = 500–1500; height 300 mm |
| Tap W1 | x = 1000; y = 4000; outlet height 900 mm |
| Drain D1 | x = 5500; y = 500 |
| Drain D2 | x = 11500; y = 7500 |
| Supporting beam centre lines below roof | x = 3000, 6000, 9000; y = 2000, 6000 |
| Supporting columns below roof | Six intersections of the listed beam centre lines; 300 × 300 mm sections |

## Load and waterproofing records
| Area | Extent | Additional permanent load allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Planting load zone | x = 6000–11000; y = 2000–6500; 22.5 m² | 300 kg/m² |
| Remaining terrace | Terrace outside the planting load zone | 150 kg/m² |

- Load allowances: saturated planting assemblies and other added permanent components.
- Waterproofing protection boundary: entire roof rectangle, 12000 × 8000 mm.
- New component interface: freestanding spreader bases over 20 mm rubber protection mats.
- Waterproofing penetrations by new components: 0.

## Container and planting records
- Container count: six, identified as C1–C6.
- Container footprint: 1200 × 600 mm; full-footprint bearing area 0.72 m².
- Container body height: 350 mm, above the 20 mm protection mat.
- Substrate depth: 180 mm.
- Saturated assembly weight: 144 kg per container, including container, substrate, plants, retained water and protection mat.
- Saturated assembly load over bearing area: 200 kg/m².
- Container material: powder-coated aluminium.

| Plant code | Plant name | Total quantity |
|---|---|---:|
| TV | Thymus vulgaris | 12 |
| OV | Origanum vulgare | 12 |
| LS | Lactuca sativa | 18 |

## Materials and maintenance
- Retained walking surface: existing pale grey concrete pavers.
- Seating material: recycled HDPE slats on freestanding aluminium frames.
- Tool cabinet outer dimensions: 1200 × 500 × 900 mm, width × depth × height.
- Watering equipment: one 15 m hose with reel at W1; two 5 L watering cans.
- Shared hand tools: four trowels and two hand forks.
- Care-board row labels: Pair 1, Pair 2, Pair 3, Pair 4, Pair 5, Pair 6.
- Care-board column labels: Water, Weed, Harvest.
- Rotation: one pair per week, repeating every six weeks.
- Routine session: 20 minutes; watering checks each morning during summer.

## Sunlight and seasonal use
- Growing Table: six hours of direct sunlight per day from May through August.
- Evening Bench: building shade after 18:00 from June through August.
- Spring scene: April, 10:00, two residents planting and watering.
- Summer scene: July, 19:00, four residents seated after garden care.

# COMMON HARVEST — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | roof-masterplan | Dimensioned roof masterplan | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | roof-section | Container, route and parapet section | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | maintenance-details | Container and maintenance detail sheet | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | materials-planting-schedule | Materials and planting schedule | 6 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |
| 5 | spring-perspective | Spring planting perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | summer-perspective | Summer evening perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
COMMON HARVEST | A shared rooftop garden for growing and gathering

Our apartment building has 12 residents who want to grow herbs and salad leaves together. Design COMMON HARVEST as a garden they can maintain in pairs, with six shared planting containers and a place for four people to sit. The roof measures 12000 × 8000 mm, an area of 96 m². Its existing concrete pavers, teal stair door and galvanized equipment plinth establish the setting. The parapet is 1100 mm high; the stair enclosure has 2400 mm clear headroom. The attached roof plan fixes the stair enclosure, supporting grid, equipment, tap and two drains.

The planting load zone occupies x = 6000–11000 mm and y = 2000–6500 mm, measured from the southwest corner. Its additional permanent load allowance is 300 kg/m²; the remaining terrace allowance is 150 kg/m². Each planting container has a 1200 × 600 mm footprint, a 350 mm body height, 180 mm of substrate and a saturated assembly weight of 144 kg, distributed across its full footprint. All additions use freestanding bases over protective mats. Retain a 500 mm perimeter access strip, 500 mm clear around the equipment and drains, and a continuous route at least 1200 mm wide from the stair door to planting, water, storage and seating. Plant 12 Thymus vulgaris, 12 Origanum vulgare and 18 Lactuca sativa. Print the site name as "COMMON HARVEST", name the two activity areas "Growing Table" and "Evening Bench", and put "Grow together, take a turn" on the maintenance station.

Audience: apartment residents and the building manager, for agreeing the garden layout, purchasing its components and assigning weekly care.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the site coordinates, load allowances, planting quantities, sunlight and maintenance records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. roof-constraints.png establishes the roof boundary, supporting grid, load zone and fixed services. parapet-container-section.png establishes the parapet height, protective base arrangement and container envelope. existing-roof.png records the recognizable pavers, teal stair door and equipment plinth. spring-shared-planting.png provides context for residents planting together. summer-evening-pause.png provides context for a short evening gathering.

Deliverables:
1. One dimensioned roof masterplan with north arrow, scale bar, fixed structures and services, load zones, six numbered containers, planting assignments, four seats and the continuous maintenance route
2. One section drawing through a planted container, the access route and parapet, with substrate, saturated weight, full-footprint support, protective layers and vertical dimensions
3. One container and maintenance detail sheet with the container assembly, tap-to-bed watering route, hose storage, tool cabinet and six-pair weekly care board
4. One materials and planting schedule covering all six containers, three plant species and quantities, retained paving, protective mats, container finishes, storage and seating
5. One spring planting perspective from the stair arrival, showing two residents tending containers and the relationship between the tap, cabinet and Growing Table
6. One summer evening perspective from the opposite end of the same garden, showing four seated residents, the same six containers and access to Evening Bench

Acceptance:
- The masterplan and section retain the 12000 × 8000 mm roof boundary and 1100 mm parapet; the masterplan locates the stair, equipment, tap and two drains at the attached coordinates and dimensions the 1200 mm route and 500 mm clearances.
- The masterplan, section and detail sheet place all six 1200 × 600 mm containers within the 300 kg/m² planting zone and label their 350 mm body height, 180 mm substrate and 144 kg saturated assembly weight; the section and details show full-footprint support and protective mats.
- The masterplan and schedule repeat COMMON HARVEST, Growing Table, Evening Bench and the three plant names exactly, with totals of 12 Thymus vulgaris, 12 Origanum vulgare and 18 Lactuca sativa assigned to containers C1–C6.
- The detail sheet traces watering from the fixed tap to C1–C6 with the 15 m hose, gives the tool cabinet dimensions of 1200 × 500 × 900 mm, and displays Grow together, take a turn above six resident-pair rows with Water, Weed and Harvest columns.
- The schedule and both perspectives carry through the existing concrete pavers, teal stair door in #2F6F73 and galvanized equipment plinth; the schedule identifies powder-coated aluminium containers, recycled HDPE seating and rubber protection mats.
- The spring and summer perspectives match the masterplan's container, cabinet and seating positions, show the two specified viewpoints and activities, and keep the maintenance-station phrase readable in both views.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
